ReleaseNotes: * Added a new application theme system with Light, Dark, and System themes.
* Added a System theme option that automatically follows the Windows application theme and responds to theme changes while VBox Tray Manager is running.
* Added theme selection to Settings with the selected theme saved between application sessions.
* Added an expandable theme architecture designed to support additional themes in the future.

* Updated the application interface for a consistent Dark theme across the Dashboard, VM Manager, Events, Settings, About, Health Center, Recovery Strategy Configuration, Logs Viewer, update windows, dialogs, notifications, and other application surfaces.
* Updated controls including buttons, tabs, combo boxes, check boxes, scroll bars, group boxes, menus, and other interface elements to properly adapt to the selected theme.
* Modernized tray and VM context menus with consistent layout, spacing, selection states, separators, and icon alignment in both Light and Dark themes.
* Updated native window title bars and application startup visuals to match the active theme.
* Improved theme switching so application windows and controls update immediately without requiring an application restart.
* Preserved the established Light appearance while extending consistent theme support throughout the application.
* Fixed several controls and interface elements that could retain Light colors while using Dark mode.
* Fixed combo boxes in Dark mode so the entire control can be clicked to open the drop-down list.
* Fixed combo box selected-item presentation so friendly display names are shown correctly instead of internal object descriptions.
* Fixed inconsistent button styling in themed dialogs and logging actions.
* Fixed update status banners, update-completion interfaces, and title-bar update controls so their appearance correctly follows the active theme.
* Fixed Health Center timeline cards so their event states remain visually distinct while respecting the selected theme.
